## Answer
Authentication flow: all clients send `Authorization: Bearer <credential>` to backend. AuthMiddleware extracts and validates via extract_bearer_token(), distinguishing API keys (0 dots) from session tokens (1+ dots). API keys verified by ApiKeyRepository.verify() with argon2id/sha256. MCP tools use @scoped_tool decorator calling require_mcp_scopes(). Hardening requires changes to 5 backend files plus client updates in frontend, Firefox extension, and Android.
